outcome: Trample changes only how an attacking creature's combat damage is assigned; a blocking trampler or noncombat damage is unaffected.
After lethal damage is assigned to all blockers, a trampling attacker's excess combat damage is dealt to the player, planeswalker or battle it attacks.
note: Names the controller's assignment choice together with its observable consequence.

outcome: A creature with trample over planeswalkers attacking a planeswalker assigns excess beyond the planeswalker's loyalty to the planeswalker's controller.
A blocked trampler whose blockers are all gone assigns all its combat damage to the defending player or planeswalker.
A trample-over-planeswalkers attacker whose planeswalker left combat deals its damage to the defending player after lethal damage to blockers, or all of it if unblocked.
A non-trample creature attacking a planeswalker deals none of its combat damage to the defending player, even if the planeswalker left combat.

note: Redundancy of instances has no separate outcome.
